name: spatial-memory
description: Local semantic memory for coding agents. Captures decisions, solutions, errors and patterns from your sessions, recalls them by meaning, and keeps each project's memories apart. One local binary; no network service.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Spatial Memory profile to use. Leave empty to use SPATIAL_MEMORY_PROFILE, a folder rule, or the default profile.

ambient_recall.title: Ambient recall
ambient_recall.description: on: add relevant memories to each prompt. off: the prompt hook prints nothing and contacts nothing.
